item.description:
### Added - **Screen OCR (`⌃ ⌥ ⌘ O`)** — drag-select any area of the screen to copy unselectable text or decode QR/barcodes with on-device Apple Vision OCR, with fast/accurate modes, line-break and toast options, and a recent-captures list in Settings - **Developer Tools** — a dedicated Screen OCR section with a stage-by-stage live capture test that pinpoints exactly where a capture fails, permission and environment inspection, an offline recognition self-check, and OCR event history - **Support Links** — GitHub Sponsors and Ko-fi links under Settings → About Toolbox
### Changed - **Call Controls** — camera on/off is now tracked alongside mic mute so the floating pill and the call session stay consistent when video toggles, all mapped call apps are monitored at once, and the pill shows a short app name for the video target - **Screen OCR** — recognizes more of the screen and keeps its structure: small text in large captures is no longer silently dropped, and multi-line selections come out as real lines and paragraphs instead of one merged line
### Fixed - **Screen OCR** — a capture that finishes after the module is disabled or the app is paused no longer writes to the clipboard, and empty results no longer false-positive on dark-themed UIs (terminals) as "screen might be blank"; failed captures are kept on disk for Reveal / Re-analyze in Developer Tools - **Call Controls** — browser-hosted web calls (Google Meet, Zoom web, etc.) no longer press the browser's own menu items by mistake, and the floating pill lands on the correct screen when pinned near a shared monitor boundary
